  candidate1_bio = 'Sherrod Brown is a veteran Democratic politician who served as Ohio''s U.S. Senator from 2007 to 2025, known for his populist economic views and strong support for labor unions. He previously served as Ohio Secretary of State and six terms in the U.S. House. Brown lost his 2024 Senate re-election bid to Bernie Moreno but is running again in the 2026 special election to reclaim the seat.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Jon Husted is a Republican politician who served as Ohio''s Lieutenant Governor under Mike DeWine from 2019 to 2025, when he was appointed to fill the Senate seat vacated by JD Vance''s elevation to Vice President. UPDATE senate_races SET
  candidate1_bio = 'Roy Cooper is a Democrat who served as North Carolina''s Governor from 2017 to 2025, winning two terms and becoming one of the few Democrats to hold statewide office in the state. Before the governorship, he served 16 years as North Carolina Attorney General. Cooper is term-limited as governor and is running for the open Senate seat being vacated by retiring Republican Thom Tillis.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Michael Whatley is a Republican attorney and political operative who has served as Chairman of the Republican National Committee since 2024, co-chairing the RNC alongside Lara Trump. He previously chaired the North Carolina Republican Party for six years. Whatley is stepping down from the RNC chairmanship to run for the Senate seat being vacated by retiring Republican Thom Tillis.'
WHERE id = 23;

UPDATE senate_races SET
  candidate1_bio = 'Cindy Burbank is a Nebraska Democrat and former state government official who served in the Nebraska Department of Natural Resources and the Nebraska Environmental Quality Council. She is running as the Democratic nominee against incumbent Republican Senator Pete Ricketts in a state that has voted Republican in every presidential election since 1968.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Pete Ricketts is a Republican who was appointed to Nebraska''s U.S. Senate seat in January 2023 to fill the vacancy left by Ben Sasse''s resignation. He previously served two terms as Nebraska''s Governor from 2015 to 2023. Ricketts is the son of TD Ameritrade founder Joe Ricketts and a co-owner of the Chicago Cubs.'
WHERE id = 19;
